title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: Anne Cohen : AD Transfer - Master Cassettes played on Nakamichi Dragon > HHB CDR830Plus > CD Ohr : CD > EAC > WAV > FLAC
source: Master Audience Cassettes - recorded by Ohr Weinberg: 2 Sony ECM-23F microphones > Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck (1st & 2nd Sets: Maxell XLII-S 90 Cassettes), Dolby B

ai_review.summary: Balanced audience recording captures a fun early‑80s show with smooth second‑set transitions
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the exceptionally balanced and clear audience (aud) capture, calling it one of the best available recordings. The performance itself is praised for its enjoyable flow, especially the seamless first four tunes of the second set, making this an overall high‑energy early‑80s Dead show.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed, consistent reviews rate the recording 4–5 stars, highlighting superb audio quality and a solid performance; this yields a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the aud as balanced, perfect, and crisp with no noted flaws, indicating top‑tier audience recording quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions between the first four tunes of the second set are specifically praised, suggesting a well‑structured flow.
